title: Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, STEM field, or equivalent practical experience.
description: Work on real-world projects, collaborate with full-time Google software engineers, and develop scalable systems serving millions of users.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
organization: Gates Cambridge Trust / University of Cambridge
eligibility: Citizens of any country outside the United Kingdom applying to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree at Cambridge.
qualification: Outstanding academic record, leadership potential, and commitment to improving the lives of others.
description: Full-cost scholarships awarded to outstanding applicants outside the UK to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree in any subject available at the University of Cambridge.

title: Software Engineer - Early Career
eligibility: Recent graduates or candidates with 0-2 years of software engineering experience.
qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical discipline.
description: Design, implement, test, and maintain cloud software components and backend services supporting Microsoft Azure and developer tools.

title: Frontend Engineer (Vue.js) - Remote
eligibility: Open globally to qualified developers with reliable internet connection.
qualification: Proficiency in JavaScript, Vue.js, HTML/CSS, Git, and modern frontend design principles.
description: Help develop user-facing features, optimize frontend performance, and contribute to the open-source GitLab DevOps platform.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to students, professionals, and self-learners worldwide with no prior coding background.
qualification: No prerequisites; open to all learning levels.
description: An entry-level course teaching algorithmic thinking and problem solving using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 18+ worldwide currently enrolled in an accredited academic institution.
qualification: Student teams of 1-4 members with an innovative tech or AI startup idea.
description: Global student technology competition encouraging young innovators to build impactful AI and software solutions to solve real-world industry challenges.
